steps.en: Install the skill into your agent
steps.zh: 把 skill 装进你的 agent

steps.en: Ships one SKILL.md whose routing table picks the workflow for your request
steps.zh: 自带一份 SKILL.md，路由表会挑出该走的工作流

steps.en: Point it at a real source instead of describing the diagram
steps.zh: 别描述图，直接把它指向真实源

steps.en: Extracts the declared architecture into Diagram IR, then lays it out and writes a validated .drawio
steps.zh: 把架构抽成 Diagram IR，布局、校验后写出可编辑的 .drawio

steps.en: Open the .drawio and hand-tune the layout
steps.zh: 用 draw.io 打开，手工微调版式

steps.en: Next time the source changes, re-syncs only what changed and keeps your coordinates
steps.zh: 源再变时只同步变化项，保留你调好的坐标

value.en: You stop redrawing the architecture every time the source moves — the .drawio stays editable and stays in sync
value.zh: 代码一改就得重画的循环结束：图始终可编辑，也始终跟得上
